text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with Ethereum's 2.1% decline slightly outpacing Bitcoin's 1.7%, suggesting mild underperformance by altcoins relative to the major pair. The Fear & Greed index remains in greed territory at 74—and has climbed 4 points over the past week—indicating investors are still risk-on despite the minor pullback. Bitcoin dominance at 58.7% and $127B in 24-hour volume point to a relatively healthy, diversified market without signs of panic rotation.
